$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary for every media field in the PageSpec schema. Derived by reading the real usage sites in src/ and the contracts in sections/. The source is a REAL, live company (Lightdash): real customer and partner trademarks, real named employees / speakers / authors, real compliance marks, a real Cal.com booking calendar, real forms, a real YouTube video and real blog / story content.

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: Abstract decoration with no real referent; new generation allowed within tokens.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Brand-owned library asset; reuse the exact approved file, never regenerate or alter.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party trademark or personal-identity / proprietary editorial asset; never generate, alter or reproduce from memory. Only a human-supplied licensed reference, else a neutral placeholder.
generationPolicies.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Never bind to a live third-party endpoint / id / host from the source site; leave an assetRef slot for a human to fill.
generationPolicies.must-be-operator-supplied: Slot is filled only with an asset (or embed / endpoint / chrome data) that the operator or user of the new site owns or has licensed; nothing from the source site.

pinNote: Every role is pinned to one specific policy, not merely to membership in the closed policy set: verify_all.py fails if any role is changed to a different valid value (proven by prove_drift.py pinned_asset_role_changed).

forbiddenLiveHostPatterns.why: live job board (the careers button targets jobs.ashbyhq.com/lightdash)

forbiddenLiveHostNote: semantic_validate.py rejects any PageSpec string value matching these case-insensitive patterns (rule NO_LIVE_ENDPOINT). Brand-owned product hosts (app.lightdash.cloud, demo.lightdash.com, docs.lightdash.com, changelog.lightdash.com, github.com/lightdash) are allowed as open-external targets.

licensing.repoVisibility: PRIVATE. Do NOT make this repository or design-repo.zip public. It cites a real company's real customers, employees, quotes, logos, compliance marks, roadmap and live endpoints.
licensing.fonts: Britti Sans Trial (Regular/Medium/Semibold/Bold) are TRIAL-licence fonts downloaded from the live site (src/index.css font-face names "Britti Sans Trial ..."); Pixelify Sans, Fragment Mono, Geist and Inter are open fonts. A licence is required before redistributing or using Britti commercially.
licensing.cloneCopyNote: Article, story, event and legal bodies in the clone are placeholder text (specs/cms-templates.md line 9, src/components/legal/placeholder.js): the real long-form copy is deliberately absent. Product-page, pricing and company-page copy IS real marketing copy and quotes of the real company.
licensing.thirdPartyScripts: Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack, Warmly, HubSpot and the Framer editor bar are NOT part of the design (CLONE_SPEC.md line 28 in section 0, and section 9; specs/SHARED.md line 352). Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack and Warmly appear in the saved original HTML; none of them is in the clone (index.html loads only /src/main.jsx): never recreate them. HubSpot is referenced only in specs/comments (the footer newsletter and forms are UI-only).

animation.rive.guidance: Brand-owned Rive files (nav wordmark, embedding hero, startups dashboard). Reuse the exact .riv; do not author new state machines.
animation.rive.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_ANIMATION); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

badge.compliance.guidance: Real compliance / award marks of a real company (AICPA SOC2, GDPR, SOC2/HIPAA rings, 8 G2 badges in the footer). Never generate a badge or imply a certification the new site does not hold.
badge.compliance.generatedModeGuidance: Blocked for generation: never bound to its live value in either mode (clone mode keeps an unfilled slot). Generation mode: the role itself is REJECTED (rule GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

decor.pixel-tile.guidance: Decorative pixel tiles, corners, bands (hero clusters, plan-card corners, post pixels, graphic border). Pure decoration without a real referent: new generation allowed within the palette.
decor.pixel-tile.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

decor.sticker.guidance: The six About-page stickers (abstract brand doodles, draggable). New stickers may be generated; they carry no real person or trademark.
decor.sticker.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

embed.booking-cal.guidance: The Cal.com booking embed (lightdash.cal.com/lightdash/talk, namespace talk-modal / start-talk, embed.js from app.cal.com). A LIVE third-party endpoint: a generated PageSpec carries an assetRef slot only; never the host, handle or embed URL.
embed.booking-cal.generatedModeGuidance: Blocked for generation: never bound to its live value in either mode (clone mode keeps an unfilled slot). Generation mode: the role itself is REJECTED (rule GENERATION_MODE_EMBED); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

embed.live-demo.guidance: The /data-apps hero iframe pointing at forecast-slider.vercel.app (a third-party deployment). Never reuse the URL; leave an assetRef slot.
embed.live-demo.generatedModeGuidance: Blocked for generation: never bound to its live value in either mode (clone mode keeps an unfilled slot). Generation mode: the role itself is REJECTED (rule GENERATION_MODE_EMBED); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

embed.youtube.guidance: The /beyond-copilots YouTube replay (video id S9NJrqRYRhs, real speakers) and its poster. Never reuse the video id, embed URL or live URL.
embed.youtube.generatedModeGuidance: Blocked for generation: never bound to its live value in either mode (clone mode keeps an unfilled slot). Generation mode: the role itself is REJECTED (rule GENERATION_MODE_EMBED); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

form.submission-endpoint.guidance: Where a form posts. The clone submits nothing (PartnerForm / PadelApply preventDefault; Footer newsletter UI-only) but the live forms post to real backends (HubSpot / Framer form backend) that were not inspected. Never bind a real form id/endpoint; leave a slot.
form.submission-endpoint.generatedModeGuidance: Blocked for generation: never bound to its live value in either mode (clone mode keeps an unfilled slot). Generation mode: the role itself is REJECTED (rule GENERATION_MODE_URL); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

icon.pixel-art.guidance: Abstract 16-84px pixel-art icons with no real referent (benefit icons, roadmap column icons, face icons, event detail icons). New icons may be generated within the pixel style and token colours.
icon.pixel-art.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

illustration.hero-diagram.guidance: Brand-owned hero SVG / PNG diagrams (e.g. conversational-analytics heroimage SVG, fintech benefit illustrations, split-row images). Reuse the exact file.
illustration.hero-diagram.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_DIAGRAM); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

illustration.html-diagram.guidance: The /context-layer HTML context diagram (src/components/pages/context-layer/context-diagram.html, 1200 lines, own prefers-reduced-motion rules). Brand-owned: reuse exactly.
illustration.html-diagram.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_DIAGRAM); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

image.cms-cover.guidance: Real blog thumbnails, story banners/logos and YouTube poster images produced by the company (public/assets/cms, ~129 files). Proprietary editorial imagery: do not regenerate or imitate; supply licensed images or placeholders.
image.cms-cover.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_ASSET); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

logo.customer-partner.guidance: Real customer, partner and co-host trademarks (nav customer cells, 6-logo rows, pricing / playground grids, fintech strip, partner strip, security tiles, event co-hosts). Never generate, redraw, recolour, reorder to imply endorsement or reproduce from memory. Only a human-supplied licensed asset may fill the slot, otherwise a neutral placeholder. Identify logos by alt text: several source file names do not match the logo they contain (public/assets/pages/fintech/hypebeast-*.png renders Wise, kraken-*.png renders Titanbay; pricing.jsx maps the "octopus energy" alt to alma-*.svg).
logo.customer-partner.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_CUSTOMER); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

logo.integration.guidance: Real third-party tool trademarks on the integrations directory (Amazon Athena, BigQuery, dbt, GitHub ...). Never redraw or invent integrations that Lightdash does not offer.
logo.integration.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_CUSTOMER); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

photo.person-avatar.guidance: Photos of real named customers, partners, speakers and blog authors (quote avatars, partner carousel portraits, speaker photos, post author avatars). Never generate a face or reuse a real person's likeness; use a human-supplied licensed photo or a neutral silhouette placeholder.
photo.person-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_PERSON); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

photo.team-member.guidance: Portraits (static + hover variant) of real employees on /about. Never generate or reuse.
photo.team-member.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_PERSON); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

screenshot.product-ui.guidance: Real Lightdash product UI screenshots (accordion / tab / card images, hero visuals). Brand-owned: reuse the exact approved file; never fabricate a fake Lightdash screen or restyle one.
screenshot.product-ui.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_SCREENSHOT); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

video.self-hosted.guidance: The brand-owned self-hosted /bi-as-code product video. Reuse the exact file; do not generate a stand-in video.
video.self-hosted.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_VIDEO); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

app.iframe-bundle.guidance: The Three.js Game Boy app bundle under public/gameboy/ (3.4 MB: index.html, GLB model, textures, sounds, vendor scripts, people/logo images of real customers). Not referenced by any PageSpec field (the homepage is an opaque iframe); documented so it is never regenerated. Its internal customer logos / people images fall under logo.customer-partner / photo.person-avatar rules.
app.iframe-bundle.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_EMBED); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

brand.lightdash-wordmark.guidance: The Lightdash wordmark / logo rendered by the navbar (static SVG + Rive state machine) and the footer. Clone mode reuses the exact file; a generated page never shows it: it carries brand.placeholder-mark or asset.operator-supplied instead.
brand.lightdash-wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_LOGO); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

content.lightdash-chrome-data.guidance: The fixed navigation / footer data of the clone (menu copy, customer cells, footer columns, G2 badges, newsletter copy, social and careers links from src/navData.js and Footer.jsx). Clone mode renders it unchanged; generation mode must bind content.operator-supplied-chrome.
content.lightdash-chrome-data.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode: may be reused exactly as in the source for fidelity. Generation mode: REJECTED by semantic_validate.py (rule GENERATION_MODE_COPY); bind one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead.

brand.placeholder-mark.guidance: A neutral placeholder or newly generated brand mark for a fictional / new brand (simple geometric mark plus the new brand name). Never derived from, traced from or styled after the Lightdash mark.
brand.placeholder-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

asset.operator-supplied.guidance: Any image, logo, badge or photo the operator / user of the new site supplies and owns or has licensed. The design-repo only reserves the slot.
asset.operator-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

illustration.generated.guidance: Newly generated illustration / diagram drawn from the token palette (no Lightdash diagram, screenshot or product UI as input or reference).
illustration.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

screenshot.placeholder.guidance: Neutral placeholder product-UI frame (grey blocks, fictional labels) standing in for a product screenshot until the operator supplies their own.
screenshot.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

animation.placeholder.guidance: Placeholder for a Rive / canvas animation slot: a static generated illustration or an operator-supplied animation file. Never a Lightdash .riv file or state machine.
animation.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

video.placeholder.guidance: Placeholder video frame (poster with a play glyph) or an operator-supplied video; never the Lightdash product video or a YouTube id from the source.
video.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

embed.operator-supplied.guidance: Slot for an iframe / booking / demo / app embed the operator supplies (their own booking page, demo or app). Until filled it renders an empty placeholder frame. Never a Lightdash iframe bundle, Cal.com handle, vercel demo or YouTube id.
embed.operator-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

endpoint.operator-supplied.guidance: Form submission endpoint configured by the operator. Placeholder URLs may only use reserved .example / .invalid hosts.
endpoint.operator-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

content.operator-supplied-chrome.guidance: Navigation / footer data supplied by the operator for the new brand (menu labels, footer columns, social links), written as original copy with placeholder (.example / .invalid) or operator-owned URLs.
content.operator-supplied-chrome.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

avatar.fictional-person.guidance: A neutral silhouette or clearly synthetic avatar for a fictional person with a fictional name; never a real employee, customer, speaker or author, and never a generated likeness of one.
avatar.fictional-person.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

logo.placeholder-company.guidance: A neutral placeholder logo tile for a fictional company (generic shape + fictional name); never a real customer, partner or integration trademark.
logo.placeholder-company.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

link.placeholder-url.guidance: Placeholder external URL on a reserved host (*.example, *.invalid per RFC 2606 / RFC 6761). Enforced on every string by semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_URL.
link.placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

copy.original.guidance: Original copy written for the new brand. Enforced by GENERATION_MODE_COPY / _CLAIM / _BRAND / _PERSON / _CUSTOMER (patterns in schema/source-identity.json).
copy.original.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: allowed in both modes. Must not reproduce, trace or imitate any Lightdash asset.

availabilityValues.clone-only: A real Lightdash (or Lightdash-cited third-party) asset. Clone mode may reuse it for fidelity; generation mode rejects it.
availabilityValues.generation-safe: Allowed in both modes; contains nothing from the source site.
availabilityValues.blocked-for-generation: A live endpoint or certification / identity claim. Never bound to its live value in either mode; generation mode rejects the role.

availabilityNote: availability is pinned three times: here (pinnedAvailability), in extraction/verify_all.py PINNED_AVAILABILITY and in schema/semantic_validate.py PINNED_AVAILABILITY. Editing the registry alone cannot loosen a role (prove_drift.py availability_* cases). A real logo / wordmark is clone-only and never must-reuse-exact in generation mode.
